complete_reason: Table S1A ('cohort characteristics of SCALLOP cohorts included in this study') lists 41 analysis rows that collapse to the IDs above; Methods say 'up to 37 cohorts (Table S1)' plus UKBB, abstract says 38 studies. The 41 rows include four obvious split pairs (BAMSE W1/W2, EPIC cases/controls, PROCARDIS cases/controls, SWEBIC lah1/swe6), which gives 37, but the paper does not state the mapping (DIRECT diabetes/prediabetics and RS/RS3 are also split rows). No cohort outside Table S1A is described as contributing pQTL summary statistics. Per-panel participation varies (panels in as_written).
